description: This file contains unit tests for the 'strbuf' module, testing initialization, addition of characters and strings, and buffer sanity checks.

methods.name: void setup(void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const void * data)
methods.description: Wrapper to initialize an empty strbuf, pass it to a test function, then release it and verify zero length and allocation.

methods.name: void setup_populated(void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const char * init_str,const void * data)
methods.description: Wrapper to initialize a strbuf with a string, pass it to a test function, then release it and verify the string was added and cleared.

methods.name: void assert_sane_strbuf(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Checks that a strbuf is in a sane state, with non-NULL buffer, NUL-terminated, and proper size relations.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__static_init(void)
methods.description: Tests that the static initializer creates a strbuf with zero length and allocation, and a null-terminated buffer.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__dynamic_init(void)
methods.description: Tests dynamic initialization of a strbuf with a specific size, verifying sanity and buffer properties.

methods.name: void t_addch(struct strbuf * buf,const void * data)
methods.description: Test helper that adds a character to the buf and verifies buffer sanity and size

methods.name: void t_addstr(struct strbuf * buf,const void * data)
methods.description: Test helper that adds a string to the buf and verifies buffer sanity and size

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_single_char(void)
methods.description: Test for adding a single character to an empty strbuf.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_empty_char(void)
methods.description: Test for adding an empty character (no-op) to an empty strbuf.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_append_char(void)
methods.description: Test for appending a character to a pre-populated strbuf.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_single_str(void)
methods.description: Test for adding a string to an empty strbuf.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_append_str(void)
methods.description: Test for appending a string to a pre-populated strbuf.

ctags.name: setup_populated
ctags.signature: (void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const char * init_str,const void * data)
